title: Apple hit a record 49% share of global smartphone revenue for Q2 - 9to5Mac
summary: A new report from Counterpoint Research (via MacMagazine ) says Apple captured a record 49% of global smartphone revenue during the last quarter, as its revenue rose 22% year over year.
